name: The Dark Light
description: Text adventures narrated by the on-board model, alone or as a party from everyone's phones: a dark lighthouse, a frozen mountain pass and a fog-bound marsh.

name: Drop
description: Send files and notes between every phone, tablet and laptop on the hotspot, and keep movies for the flight.

name: Cinema
description: Watch the films and shows, and play the music, loaded onto Drop. Every device picks up where it left off.

name: QuickShot
description: An endless feed of the short videos in Drop's QuickShot folder. Swipe, like, comment.

name: Doom
description: The classic shooter, running on your device with touch controls. Freedoom, the Layover airport episode, or your own WADs from Drop.

name: Travel Guide
description: All of Wikivoyage, offline. Look up any destination, or ask a question and get an answer from the guide.

name: Gate Change
description: A fast colour-and-number card game for 2 to 8 players. Play friends on the hotspot from every phone, or bots.

name: Passport
description: A travel deck-building card game. Collect stamps and visas against friends on the hotspot, or bots.

name: Wayfarer
description: Travel trivia from the Travel Guide: capitals, currencies, airport codes, phrases. Daily flight, endless mode, high scores.

name: The Couch
description: A therapist simulator: talk things over with a Stoic or a Socialist, played by the on-board model. Not real therapy.
